messages:
mira-cs: quick heads-up — Pleroma hit another latency/error spike this morning around 08:12 UTC, looks like the same pattern as last week's incident.
jason-sre: saw it, pulled logs. 502s from the backend pool, slow KV cache miss rate spiked.
liam-eng: any deploys around that time? I don't see new image rollouts.
jason-sre: no deploys. suspect autoscaler throttled a worker group during peak and cache warming failed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — #PL-4621 Pleroma latency spike (automated alert). Severity: P2. Owner: jason-sre.
mira-cs: copying key account notes: Pleroma is on a committed Dedicated cluster, churn is sensitive. Renewals in Q3 — flagging as medium risk until we have permanent fixes.
alexa-ce: customer reported degraded UX in their staging → affecting onboarding for two new teams. They want ETA on fixes.
liam-eng: can reproduce locally with a synthetic workload. I'll open a PR for a guard that prevents aggressive scale-down during warming.
jason-sre: action items: 1) add an alert for KV miss-rate + scale-down correlation (me) 2) temp autoscaler tweak to be less aggressive (liam) 3) runbook update + postmortem doc (mira + jason)
mira-cs: adding enablement ask: schedule a 30-min call with Pleroma ops next Tue to walk through retry/backoff knobs and recommended batching settings.
liam-eng: working on PR: draft autoscaler change here:

```
# quick excerpt
min_replicas: 2
scale_down_cooldown: 300s
warmup_grace: true
```

jason-sre: proposed alert rule (prometheus):
```
alert: HighKVCacheMissWithScaleDown
expr: increase(kv_cache_misses[10m]) > 50 and scale_down_events_total[10m] > 0
for: 5m
```
mira-cs: thanks — can you add that to the customer-facing runbook? I want a one-pager they can share with their ops.
alexa-ce: I'll sync with them and confirm availability for Tue afternoon UTC. Also collecting incident timeline from their side.
mira-cs: ownership spelled out: SRE = jason-sre (alert + runbook), Eng = liam-eng (autoscaler patch + canary), CS = mira-cs (customer comms + renewal note), CE = alexa-ce (enablement call + tapes). Please update when you claim tasks.
liam-eng: claimed autoscaler patch, will push canary by EOD and monitor.
jason-sre: claimed alert and initial runbook draft, will attach logs and playbook by EOD.
alexa-ce: claimed enablement scheduling and collecting customer logs.
mira-cs: noted. Risk: renewal moved to "watch" until next week if no recurrence. I'll send an account update after we confirm no repeat for 72h.
liam-eng: quick question — do we want a short-term mitigation (cache pre-warm job) or rely on autoscaler fix?
jason-sre: short-term pre-warm cron could help; I'll add a job to run during peak for the next 48h.
mira-cs: please post links to PRs and runbook here when available.
incident-bot: UPDATE — Alert resolved (PL-4621) at 08:45 UTC, auto-mitigation triggered.
mira-cs: great, please keep monitoring. I'll follow up in next weekly account check-in and include these action items.
alexa-ce: scheduled call proposed for Tue 14:00 UTC, inviting Pleroma ops + their dev lead.
liam-eng: can confirm canary results by tomorrow morning.
jason-sre: will validate alert noise and tune thresholds if needed.
mira-cs: thanks team :thumbsup: — adding to the account health doc and tagging renewal owner.
